Checking whether external storage types use a presign runner or another mechanism.

The runner only handles S3 attachments. Now checking what EXTERNAL storage means.

External attachments use a URL reference that does not require presigning.

`s3presign.Runner` refreshes S3 presigned URLs before expiry. It runs `CheckAndPresign`, which refreshes URLs older than four days out of a five-day window. The schedule is every twelve hours. Wiring site: `server.go` line 123.

`Start` calls `startBackgroundRunners(ctx)` at line 129. The runner itself is configured inside that function at lines 161–171.

The runner also executes once immediately at startup via RunOnce at line 163.
